Problem Statement:
Given a number N in decimal, print the length of the corresponding binary digit. 
Input Description:
The input consists of a number N in decimal, where 1 <= N <= 100000. 
Output Description:
The output is the length of the binary representation of N. 
Sample Input:
10 
Sample Output:
4
